invariants.rationale: An update operation should have a non-null, non-empty instantTime to identify the commit.
The partitionPath should be specified for an update, so it's likely non-null and non-empty.
A specific fileId is targeted for update, so should be non-null and non-empty.
The update operation must have new records to update, so the map should be non-null and not empty.
handleUpdate operates on an existing data file, so oldDataFile should be non-null.
